title: viburnum deamii var. indianense
intro: Viburnum deamii var. indianense, commonly known as the Indian Cranberry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Adoxaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and its potential to reduce inflammation. The Indian Cranberry is said to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects and benefits.
